title: Page 5
slug: 仇人逼我嫁-芳妮-孟佳梨没想到当年老被她保护的小胖子竟变成眼前的帅哥总裁-他曾发誓以后换他保护她可现在欺负她最狠的就是他
content_zh:
三个男生微微退了一步，以往他们欺负小男孩时，孟佳梨都会替他出头，虽然她是女生，却修长高跳，长得比他们这几个男生都还要快，个头也是最高的，虽然真打起来她占不了便宜，但站出来也算是架式十足，加上她的功课总是名列前茅，

在老师眼中是个品学兼优的好学生，每次冲突之后倒霉的总是他们，所以对孟佳梨，他们虽然恨得牙痒痒的，但也还是有所忌惮，不过现在不在校园内，老师管不到他们。

“你、你妈妈才是死了咧。”带头的大个儿涨红了脸，不甘示弱的反击。

“对啊，没妈妈的孤儿。”

“没妈妈的孤儿。”

两个跟班马上附和。

“闭嘴，她不是孤儿，她还有爸爸！”小男孩见孟佳梨的脸色倏地刷白，一股从未有过的愤怒自胸臆升起。

“哟，我们都忘记了，你跟她一样是没妈妈的孤儿，难怪会喜欢她，哈哈哈哈。”带头的胖虎指着小男孩哈哈大笑，两个跟班的笑声也随之响起。

小男孩的脸一阵青一阵白，全身因为激动而颤抖着。

“孤儿爱孤儿，孤儿爱孤儿——”三个男生开始有节奏的重复大喊，带着浓浓的嘲弄意味。

小男孩细长的双眼燃起熊熊怒火，下颚一绷，脚步跟着跨出，可还没落到地上，身后已经传来了女生的怒骂。

“欠揍！”

小男孩眼前一晃，孟佳梨已经越过他冲了出去，一头撞向了带头的男生。

“打人啦，大家上！”几个男生也不甘示弱的群起迎上。

小男孩看着孟佳梨一个人被三个男生团团围住，眼睛顿时通红，大叫一声，跟着冲上前助阵。

几个小学生瞬间在洞内打成一团，而洞外不知何时开始下起了雨，淅淅沥沥，细小的雨丝逐渐变成争先恐后坠落的水珠，哗哗作响。

“死胖子，你敢打我？”

“痛死我了，男人婆，我跟你拚了。”

“打她。”

“打他。”

“你们住手，要就冲着我来！”小男生鼓起勇气嘶吼。

“闭嘴，别碍手碍脚！”孟佳梨不领情的骂了声。

“哎哟——”

几个小孩叫喊的声音随着一阵拳打脚踢飘入了雨中，天气虽冷，洞内却是火气十足。

“喂，你们几个人在做什么？！还不住手！”一阵斥喝声忽地在洞口响起。

几个小孩子顿时止住了动作，愣愣的看着撑着伞，站在洞口的男人。

“是隔壁班老师！”小跟班心一惊，低声喊道。

“快闪。”带头的男生头一扭，不管三七二十一，埋头就往雨中冲。

“等等我们。”两个跟班也跟着开溜。

“欸，你们站住——”似乎没料到他们会这样冒着雨逃跑，老师错愕的看着三条身影大喊。

胖胖的小男孩愣愣的站在原地，还来不及做任何反应，手腕已经被往外一扯。

“站着干么？还不跑？”孟佳梨没好气的瞪了他一眼，随即趁着老师的注意力还放在先闪的那三个男生身上时，快速拉着他从老师身旁钻了出去，头也不回的狂奔。

“喂！你们两个快回来！”老师发现连剩下两个打群架的小孩也溜走了，举步想追上前，却不小心绊了一跤，跌趴在泥上，眼镜甩落到一旁，怒气腾腾的朝越跑越远的模糊背影骂道：“老师知道你们是谁，明天到学校跟老师报到！”

“欸，老师跌倒了耶……”小男孩回头看着跌坐在泥泞中的男人，忐忑的报告。

孟佳梨松开了抓着他手腕的手，脚步没有停歇，有点沙哑的声音自风雨中飘来，“你想回去自己回去。”

小男孩顿“顿，决定还是跟着孟佳梨，他实在很担心她。

“你干么一直跟着我？”孟佳梨一直跑到距防空洞很远的大树下才停下脚步，大口喘着气。

“我、我答应过孟妈妈，要帮她照顾你，保护你。”

想到病逝的母亲，孟佳梨的眼眶又红了起来，举起手佯装擦去脸上的水珠，带着点赌气的道：“你不要扯我后腿就好。”

“我知道以前都是你帮我出头，不过以后不会了，以后我一定不让任何人欺负你。”小男孩赶紧举起手保证。

孟佳梨看了他一眼，浓密的长睫低垂下来，遮去了她眸底的感动。

他们两个人其实算是青梅竹马，小男孩虽然大她两岁，但因为幼时的车祸意外，不但失去了母亲，还重伤住院了好一阵子，所以延后就学，只比她高一届，而他刚出生不久的妹妹则因为父亲一个人无法妥善照顾，不得已交给了外婆抚养，与他们分隔两地。

双方的父亲是换帖兄弟，从年轻时代就私交甚笃，可以说是比亲兄弟还要亲的关系，所以他们两个人从小接触的机会也很多，加上他母亲很早就去世了，所以前几年孟母身体状况还不错的时候，小男孩也常常在下课后先到她家待着，等他父亲忙完再来接他回家。

父亲虽然曾要她多陪陪他，不过她一直对他被欺负却隐忍不还手感到不以为然，就算常常忍不住替他出头，但也不太搭理他。

没想到今天他却为她动手了，这倒是让她有些讶异，也对他有点改观了……

“你不相信吗？我是说真的，我发誓绝不会再让人欺负你！”小男孩见她迟迟不语，着急的又举起手来发誓，胖胖的脸颊除了雨水，竟还沁出了汗水。

孟佳梨看了他严肃认真的圆圆脸庞一眼，突然又跨步冲出了树下。

“佳梨？”小男孩有点失望的垂下了手。

“还不快点走，我把你的外套忘在防空洞了。”孟佳梨顿了顿脚步，回头喊着，声音带着点软化的尴尬。

这意思是她不再赶他了？小男孩圆圆的脸蛋绽出抹傻笑。

“傻蛋耿柏恩。”孟佳梨被他的笑容感染，忍不住也弯起了唇瓣，转过身又跑了。

“只要你开心，怎么叫我都没关系。”耿伯恩不以为忤的大声响应，追着她的身影冲入了雨中。

“傻蛋耿柏恩……”孟佳梨站在窗边，望着夜色，轻吐着回忆中的字句。

她还记得那次在防空洞内从他外套传来的温暖，还有他在大树下的宣誓——以后绝对不会让别人欺负她。

后来那场雨让耿伯恩大病一场，她也被父亲责斥了一顿，还是耿柏恩发着高烧来替她求情，而那次，也是她第一次在父亲面前放纵的哭泣。

从此以后，他真的实践了他的诺言，认真学习起跆拳道、合气道，各式各样可以增加自己能力的武术，不再是那个任人欺负，需要她跳出来维护他的弱者，成了时时挡在她前面，守护着她的大树。她逐渐依赖起他，喜欢他的陪伴，他们之间的强弱在不知不觉中转换，唯一不变的，是他那双充满温暖，总是带着微笑、漾满宠溺的目光。

孟佳梨脑中的那张福态脸庞，慢慢跟另一张斧鏊似的冷硬线条迭合在一起，记忆中总是温柔的瞳眸，也被阴沉犀利的冷芒给覆盖。

真的是他吗？他的改变好大好大，大到她记忆中那个弥勒佛似的好好先生，完全没有一丝曾经存在的痕迹。

现在的他俊美无俦，衣衫下的肌肉贲张可见，整个人沉稳有威严，就像只猎豹般，即便没有任何动作，依然充满了危险的压迫感。

他真的是耿柏恩吗？

耿柏恩……这个名字一直深深烙印在她的记忆深处，虽然已经许久未曾听人提起，却是她童年最深刻的回忆。
content_en:
The three boys took a step back slightly. In the past, when they bullied the little boy, Meng Jiali would stand up for him. Although she was a girl, she was tall and slender. She grew faster than the boys and was the tallest. Although she couldn't really take advantage of them in a fight, she still had a strong attitude when she stood up. In addition, she was always among the best in her homework.

In the eyes of the teacher, he is a good student with both good character and academic performance. After every conflict, they are always the unlucky ones. Therefore, although they hate Meng Jiali with itch, they are still afraid of her. However, they are not on campus now, so the teacher can't control them.

"You, your mother is the one who is dead." The big man in the lead blushed and fought back not to be outdone.

"Yes, an orphan without a mother."

"A motherless orphan."

The two followers immediately agreed.

"Shut up, she's not an orphan, she has a father!" The little boy saw Meng Jiali's face turn pale suddenly, and an unprecedented anger rose in his chest.

"Hey, we have all forgotten, you are a motherless orphan like her, no wonder you like her, hahahaha." The leader, Fat Tiger, pointed at the little boy and laughed, and the two followers also laughed.

The little boy's face turned blue and white, and his whole body was trembling with excitement.

"Orphans love orphans, orphans love orphans -" the three boys began to shout repeatedly in a rhythmic manner, with a strong sense of mockery.

The little boy's slender eyes were blazing with anger, his jaw tightened, and he stepped forward, but before he even landed on the ground, the girl's angry curses came from behind him.

"Deserves a beating!"

As soon as the little boy's eyes flashed, Meng Jiali had already rushed out past him and bumped into the leading boy.

"Hit someone, everyone, come on!" Not to be outdone, several boys gathered together to meet him.

When the little boy saw Meng Jiali being surrounded by three boys, his eyes suddenly turned red. He yelled and rushed forward to help.

Several primary school students huddled together inside the cave in an instant, but it began to rain at some point outside the cave. It was pouring, and the fine raindrops gradually turned into water drops that were rushing to fall, making a loud splash.

"Damn fat man, you dare to hit me?"

"It hurts me to death, man, I'll fight you."

"Hit her."

"Hit him."

"Stop it, come at me if you want!" the little boy mustered up the courage to yell.

"Shut up and stay out of the way!" Meng Jiali scolded ungratefully.

"Ouch——"

The shouts of several children floated into the rain along with a burst of punches and kicks. Although the weather was cold, the cave was full of fire.

"Hey, what are you guys doing?! Stop it!" A burst of scolding suddenly sounded at the entrance of the cave.

Several children suddenly stopped moving and looked blankly at the man standing at the entrance of the cave holding an umbrella.

"It's the teacher from the next class!" The little follower was startled and shouted in a low voice.

"Flash." The leading boy turned his head and rushed into the rain regardless of the situation.

"Wait for us." The two followers also fled.

"Hey, stop—" As if he didn't expect them to run away in the rain like this, the teacher looked at the three figures in astonishment and shouted.

The fat little boy stood there in a daze. Before he could react, his wrist was pulled out.

"What are you doing standing here? Why don't you run?" Meng Jiali glared at him angrily, and then while the teacher's attention was still on the three boys who had dodged first, she quickly pulled him out of the teacher's side and ran away without looking back.

"Hey! You two, come back quickly!" The teacher noticed that even the remaining two children who were fighting in a group had slipped away. He tried to catch up, but accidentally tripped and fell on the mud. His glasses fell aside and he angrily cursed at the blurry figure running further and further away: "The teacher knows who you are. Report to the teacher at school tomorrow!"

"Hey, the teacher fell down..." The little boy looked back at the man who fell in the mud and reported anxiously.

Meng Jiali released her grip on his wrist, and without stopping, a hoarse voice floated from the wind and rain, "If you want to go back, go back on your own."

The little boy paused and decided to follow Meng Jiali. He was really worried about her.

"Why do you keep following me?"Meng Jiali ran to the big tree far away from the air raid shelter before she stopped, gasping for air.

"I, I promised Mother Meng that I would help her take care of you and protect you."

Thinking of her mother who died of illness, Meng Jiali's eyes turned red again, she raised her hands and pretended to wipe away the water drops on her face, and said with a bit of anger: "Just don't hold me back."

"I know you were the one who stood up for me in the past, but you won't do it anymore. I will never let anyone bully you in the future."The little boy quickly raised his hand to assure himself.

Meng Jiali glanced at him, her thick long eyelashes lowered, covering up the emotion in her eyes.

The two of them were actually childhood sweethearts. Although the little boy was two years older than her, he not only lost his mother in a car accident when he was young, but was also seriously injured and was hospitalized for a long time. Therefore, he postponed his schooling and was only one grade higher than her. His newly born sister was forced to be raised by his grandmother because his father could not take care of her properly alone, and they were separated from each other.

The fathers of both parties were exchange brothers. They had a close personal relationship since they were young. It could be said that the relationship was closer than that of real brothers. Therefore, the two of them had many opportunities to interact with each other since they were young. In addition, his mother passed away very early. Therefore, in the past few years, when Meng's mother was in good health, the little boy would often stay at her house after class, waiting for his father to finish his work before picking him up.

Although her father had asked her to spend more time with him, she had always been dissatisfied with how he tolerated not fighting back when he was bullied. Even though she often couldn't help but stand up for him, she didn't pay much attention to him.

Unexpectedly, he would do something for her today, which surprised her a little, and also changed her view of him a little bit...

"Don't you believe it?I mean it, I swear I will never let anyone bully you again!" Seeing that she was still silent, the little boy raised his hands anxiously and swore again. In addition to the rain, the little boy's cheeks were actually covered with sweat.

Meng Jiali glanced at his serious, round face, and suddenly stepped out of the tree again.

"Jia Li?"The little boy lowered his hands a little disappointed.

"Hurry up and leave, I forgot your coat in the air raid shelter."Meng Jiali paused and shouted back, her voice softened by embarrassment.

Does this mean she won't chase him away anymore?The little boy's round face broke out into a silly smile.

"You idiot Gunn." Meng Jiali was infected by his smile and couldn't help but curl her lips, turned around and ran away again.

"As long as you are happy, it doesn't matter what you call me."Geng Boen responded loudly without feeling dissatisfied, and chased her figure into the rain.

"Silly Geng Bo'en..." Meng Jiali stood by the window, looking at the night, whispering the words in her memories.

She still remembered the warmth that came from his coat in the air-raid shelter, and his oath under the big tree that he would never let others bully her in the future.

Later, the rain made Geng Burn seriously ill, and she was scolded by her father. It was Geng Burn who had a high fever and came to plead for her, and that time was also the first time she cried indulgently in front of her father.

From then on, he really fulfilled his promise and seriously studied Taekwondo, Aikido, and various martial arts that could increase his abilities. He was no longer the weakling who allowed others to bully him and needed her to jump out to defend him, but became the big tree that always stood in front of her and protected her.She gradually became dependent on him and liked his company. The strength between them changed unconsciously. The only thing that remained unchanged was his warm, always smiling and doting eyes.

The blessed face in Meng Jiali's mind slowly overlapped with the cold and hard lines of another face like an axe. The gentle eyes in her memory were also covered by a gloomy and sharp cold light.

Is it really him?He had changed so much that in her memory, there was no trace of the good Mr. Maitreya Buddha that he once existed.

He is now extremely handsome, and the muscles under his clothes are visibly flexing. His whole person is calm and majestic, like a cheetah. Even without any movement, he is still full of dangerous oppression.

Is he really Gunn?

Geng Boen... this name has always been deeply imprinted in her memory. Although she has not heard anyone mention it for a long time, it is the most profound memory of her childhood.
